messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P1 -> CUDA_MEMORY_PRESSURE detected on infer-west2a-pool-7. gpu_free_mb falling below 800MB for >30s across 3/8 nodes. firing policies: auto-evacuate=false, escalate=true. metrics: GC_RATE=high, KV_CACHE_EVICTIONS=spike

pd-bot: PagerDuty incident created: INC1234567. Escalation level: first oncall paging to alex. https://pagerduty.example/INC1234567 :rotating_light:

alex: acked INC1234567. I'm on it, pinging runtime and sre. switching to channel thread for comms. :eyes:

sam: taking lead on runtime. quick check: model redwood-lite-2.7B-quant shows sustained KV cache growth on these nodes. suspecting cache leak + large sequence length requests. pulling logs now.

maya: i'm watching infra. noticing node infer-west2a-07 with nvml alloc failures in dmesg: `NVRM: Xid 31: GPU memory fault` and `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` in pod logs. prepping cordon/drain.

sam: paste of relevant logs:
```
2026-03-17T03:42:10Z runtime[pid=4210]: model=redwood-lite-2.7B-quant seq=2048 kv_cache_bytes=7.8GB
2026-03-17T03:42:40Z runtime[pid=4210]: ERROR cuda: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation at forward_step()
2026-03-17T03:43:05Z runtime[pid=4210]: GC trigger: kv_cache_evict=0.12s, evictions=0.0
```

alex: what's customer impact? any 5xxs or rate-limited requests?

sam: telemetry shows a 12% spike in 500s for hosted API customers routed through west2a; most errors are OOM retries causing latency/timeouts. blackbox shows a handful of customers with increased error rates: CUST-914, CUST-1071.

maya: executing mitigation: cordon infer-west2a-07, drain pods -> will reroute new sessions off that node. issuing `kubectl drain infer-west2a-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

ops-bot: Action queued: drain job started for node infer-west2a-07 (job id: drain-349876-1). Estimated completion ~90s.

sam: while draining, enabling temporary fallback to cpu-infer pool for new low-priority requests. patching routing: set route weight model=redwood-lite-2.7B-quant west2a->cpu-infer=30% for 10m.

alex: good. also increase burst capacity: request +2 gpus to west2a pool (if available) and hold canary. pinging capacity team.

devon: support notified CUST-914 and CUST-1071 that we observed elevated errors and are mitigating; will follow up with timeline once stabilized. ticket refs: SUP-8821, SUP-8822.

maya: drain finished. infer-west2a-07 evacuated, pods rescheduled across nodes. memory reclaim observed: GPU free went from ~600MB -> ~6.9GB on affected hosts.

sam: restarted runtime worker on node, added a mitigation hotfix: decrease per-request KV prefetch window for redwood-lite-2.7B-quant: `kv_prefetch_window=128` (was 512). This reduces peak KV usage. Rolling out to 50% of pods now.

alex: monitoring. metrics trending back to normal. 500s dropped to baseline within 3m. latency for affected customers improved but we still need post-incident follow-up. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: PagerDuty INC1234567 auto-resolve attempted. Manual confirm required by alex.

alex: marking INC1234567 as acknowledged->resolved at 3498765660. Will schedule postmortem with runtime + infra + support.

sam: note for postmortem: look into KV cache eviction logic with large sequence lengths + quantized model memory accounting. potential long-term fixes: stricter per-session prefetch caps, proactive mem-scrub on LRU, and early OOM guards.

devon: I'll draft customer-facing note and update SUP tickets with timeline and mitigation steps.

maya: assigning follow-up tasks: infra to add node-level nvml alert for Xid 31 and auto-evac threshold at gpu_free_mb<1GB for 45s.

alex: thanks team. handoff to sam and devon for post-incident actions. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
